messages:
Ivy Tran: quick thread  the variant rail in the rollout inspector looks cramped when there are 5+ variants. chips wrap and push the timeline down. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/variant-rail-density.png

Markus - Eng: yep. wrapping causes layout jump. options: horizontal scroll, collapse into a "+N" overflow, or stack with a vertical scroller inside the rail. tradeoffs?

Sasha - PM: priority is scannability and keyboard nav. users need quick access to variant labels and allocation %s. overflow +N that expands a flyout feels promising. keep the primary two variants inline.

Ivy Tran: design idea: show up to 3 chips then a compact "more" chip that opens a popover listing remaining variants with full labels and actions (promote, inspect, edit). keep chip heights consistent.

Markus - Eng: engineering note: popover items must be focusable and support arrow navigation. Also preserve ARIA roles and ensure virtualized list for orgs with many variants. we can implement expand-on-hover for desktop and tap for mobile.

Sasha - PM: copy for more chip: "+{N} more". inside popover line: "Variant name D 12%" with a tertiary 'Inspect' link. primary actions (Promote/Disable) should be buttons in each row.

access-bot: accessibility check: ensure focus trap inside popover, provide aria-expanded on the more chip, keyboard support for opening/closing, and visible focus indicator. contrast for chip text >=4.5:1.

Ivy Tran: micro-interaction: when user promotes variant from popover, animate chip into the inline rail with a short scale/fade (reduced-motion respected). Also shift the allocation pill to reflect new %s smoothly.

Markus - Eng: technical: avoid DOM reordering for screen readers. animate by visually moving a cloned element but keep DOM order stable. will prototype.

Sasha - PM: metrics: variant_overflow_shown, variant_promote_from_popover, variant_open_popover_keyboard. target: reduce accidental scroll taps by 60% on mobile.

Ivy Tran: action items: I'll add the "3 + more" mock and popover rows to Figma. Markus will prototype keyboard and focus behaviour. Sasha will add telemetry. Ship in next minor UI update.

Markus - Eng: tagging @ivy @sasha. I'll mock up the focusable list and virtualized rows tomorrow.

Ivy Tran: thanks all D uploading frames now.
